messages:
liz: quick idea as we plan v3->v4 cutover: we need a compatibility playbook, not just a single shim. define placement, lifetime, telemetry, and tenant controls. thoughts? :thinking:
amar: agree. runtime shims for tiny shape diffs, adapter layer for larger migrations. keep hotpath minimal.
sasha: SDKs must warn users. if we hide breaks in server shims customers won't realize until later. add local deprecation logs in SDKs.
kevin: propose telemetry signals: percent routed to shim, delta error-rate, latency overhead, and a per-tenant regression score.
olivia (pm): add a TTL policy for shims (auto-expire after N months), and no-silent-deletions rule for removed fields.
liz: concrete: header `X-RI-Compat: v3` routes to compat. shim placement: edge proxy for routing+idempotent transforms, runtime for KV/token fallbacks. tags like `ri.compat.v3` and `ri.compat.translation=header|body|proto`.
amar: ops notes: edge transforms must be idempotent; runtime shims avoid copies (views/mapped buffers).
sasha: SDK plan: `Client.enableCompat('v3')` sets header and emits a local migration warning with link. release in next minor.
kevin: add daily scan job that runs compat evals and auto-files an incident if regressions exceed threshold.
olivia (pm): private deployments need tenant-level toggle `compat_enabled`. precedence: tenant toggle overrides default, header overrides tenant toggle.
amar: dark-launch canary: route 1% of v3 traffic through v4 translation to detect silent issues.
sasha: testing: unit translation tests, edge+runtime integration tests, KV-cache integrity checks, nightly compat eval suite using anonymized prompts (`tests/compat/`).
kevin: perf budget per shim: avg <10ms, p95 <40ms; mark "expensive" if exceeded and require opt-in.
liz: header format suggestion `X-RI-Compat: v3;reason=client_sdk;ts=1670000000`, `X-RI-Compat-Debug:1` for verbose traces.
amar: implementation: small library `redwood/compat/v3` with pure `normalize_request`/`normalize_response`. SDKs can vendor minimal helpers.
kevin: telemetry naming use dotted keys `ri.compat.v3.*`. avoid logging raw payloads; log hashes + masked samples; tenant consent toggle for richer traces.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: compat-shim-prototype -> staging @4300000105 :rocket:
olivia (pm): timeline: RFC+prototype this sprint, canary next sprint, tenant opt-in over 6-8 weeks, migration docs and deprecation notice week 10, sunset only after 3 months with no active opt-ins.
liz: next actions: amar -> shim diagram, sasha -> SDK warning text, kevin -> thresholds/perf budgets, olivia -> comms + docs. I'll assemble RFC PR by EOD Friday. archive this thread. :white_check_mark:
